environment.concurrent_load_context: Main task was running renderer/native Katana verification concurrently; timings are not an isolated-load benchmark.

limits: Synthetic findings and headless Swing only; not actual Burp GUI.

EDT update intervals exclude queue waiting and worker calculation; readiness end-to-end includes queue wait, worker calculation, UI publication and up to 10ms polling delay. Snapshot construction, native window layout and paint are excluded.
Cached batches include 6 card and 4 severity changes, JTable updates and simple count assertions.
No fake packets, Burp API, HTTP runner or network client is constructed.
Concurrent renderer/release verification execution may affect timings; no pass/fail latency threshold is defined.
Five samples include JVM/JIT warmup effects after a small 100-finding warmup.
coalescing_validation: Not restressed by this timing harness; reviewed separately in controlled ScopeInspectionDashboardAsyncTest.
